Toddler meals

Vegetable and cheese frittata

Sajtos zöldséges frittata

8 months+ Adjusted 35 min 4 portions

Serve warm in soft squares. A little mild pasteurized cheese is enough.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 4 Eggs (Beaten)
  • 1 medium Potato (Peeled and sliced thin)
  • 100 g Broccoli (Small florets)
  • 30 g Mild cheese (Pasteurized, grated; a modest amount)

Allergens

eggmilk

Method

  1. Simmer the potato and broccoli in water until just soft, then drain.
  2. Heat the oven to 180°C.
  3. Lay the vegetables in a small dish and pour the eggs over them.
  4. Scatter on the cheese.
  5. Bake until the egg is set all the way through, about 18 minutes.
  6. Cool slightly and cut into soft squares.

Adjusted

A thick layer of salty cheese is too much for this dish. The egg has to be baked until set, with no liquid centre.

Bake egg with a little mild cheese, broccoli, and potato. Keep the cheese modest and add no salt.
